provenance.source: new: 2026-10-24 real-host check. Claude Code 2.1.302-2.1.306 give plugins no Tab, Shift+Tab or Escape, so a template's fields can't be moved between there; fields with a default are filled at expansion, and the rest stay as visible placeholders the user edits. The one-time unfilled-field warning is what keeps `<issue>` from reaching the model
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: Claude shows the block as 'Prompt dropped by a hook: 2 template fields not filled; Enter again to send anyway' and keeps the draft; the second Enter sends it as it is. Catches a warning that loses the draft, repeats forever, or never comes.
